title: Add Author Section to README.md
description: Update the project's root README.md file to include an 'Author' or 'Credits' section attributing the project to RafiulM, with a link to their GitHub profile.
details: Open the README.md file at the root of the repository. Add a new section titled '## Author' or '## Credits' near the end of the document, following existing formatting conventions. In this section, include the following attribution: 'This project was created and is maintained by [RafiulM](https://github.com/RafiulM).' Ensure the Markdown syntax is correct and the section is placed logically (e.g., before the License section if present). Save the file.
test_strategy: Manually review the updated README.md in a Markdown viewer (such as GitHub's web interface) to confirm the new section renders correctly, the author's name and link are accurate, and formatting matches the rest of the document.
